components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Terminal command button. Outlined phosphor on carbon; fills on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.7rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--green); background: var(--green-bg); border: 1px solid var(--green); border-radius: 0; padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--green); color: var(--bg); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary command. Transparent with a strong hairline.

narrative.overview: The portfolio behaves like a tool left open on a developer's desk: a quiet terminal, a status line, a file tree of evidence. It is not a retro CRT costume and it is not a generic dark SaaS dashboard. Surfaces are flat, divisions are 1px hairlines, and the phosphor green is a signal rather than a paint job. Type does most of the work; decoration is limited to the code-native details that a working interface would actually have.
keyCharacteristics: Square corners; no pills, no soft cards.
JetBrains Mono at every level, including display.
Phosphor green reserved for state, action and section prefixes.
Syntax accents (amber, blue) used only where a value or number needs a different voice.
Keyboard-first: visible focus rings and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Phosphor green covers less than 10% of any screen. Its rarity is what makes an active state legible.

rules.name: The No Green Body Rule
rules.body: Green is a signal, not a reading color. Body copy uses Ink, Ink Muted or Ink Subtle.

rules.name: The Single Voice Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce a second typeface. If a section needs emphasis, change weight or size before changing family.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: If a component needs to separate itself, add a hairline or move one tonal step. Do not add a shadow.

dos: Do keep the accent under 10% of the viewport; use it for state and action.
Do separate surfaces with 1px hairlines and tonal steps.
Do keep every interactive element keyboard-reachable with a visible focus ring.
Do use JetBrains Mono for display, body and labels.
Do keep the light theme as warm paper and darken the green to #00733a for AA.
donts: Don't add shadows, glass, gradients or blurred halos to the product UI.
Don't round cards or buttons; the square edge is the identity.
Don't use phosphor green for long body copy.
Don't animate opacity on text that carries information.
Don't fabricate metrics, logos, testimonials or client names.
